managed_generative_ai.rationale: Managed enterprise access to Gemini models, evaluation, governance, and AI development capabilities.

serverless_application.rationale: Managed container runtime for the web application and orchestration layer with autoscaling.

analytics_data.rationale: Enterprise analytics warehouse and governed source for structured operational data.

document_storage.rationale: Document source and durable object storage for unstructured customer knowledge.

identity_access.rationale: Centralized permissions and least-privilege access control for cloud resources.

observability.rationale: Operational visibility, audit trails, service health, and alerting.
